featured.title: AutoRespond
featured.summary: A detection-as-code harness that loads Sigma rules and runs them against simulated AWS CloudTrail logs, with pytest tests so a rule change gets checked before it ships.
featured.angle: Treats detections like code: versioned, tested, and tuned against real-looking log data instead of guesswork.

featured.title: Project Hub
featured.summary: A local control panel for everything I run on localhost. It finds new services by watching listening ports, shows what's up, and starts or stops them.
featured.angle: A local tool that runs shell commands is a CSRF target. It checks Host and Origin and requires a custom header, which blocks cross-site requests and DNS rebinding.

featured.title: Job Pipeline
featured.summary: Collects security job postings every morning, scores them against my profile with an LLM, and pre-fills applications in my own browser for me to review and submit.
featured.angle: Guardrails first: LLM calls run with no tool access, personal data stays in a gitignored file and out of prompts, scraping is rate-limited, and it never submits anything on its own.

featured.title: Travel Dashboard
featured.summary: A self-hosted travel atlas built from my photo library and drone footage: a 3D globe of every trip with day-by-day galleries.
featured.angle: Split into two servers. The owner server never leaves my LAN and Tailscale. Only a separate read-only build, with hidden items stripped out, is published through Tailscale Funnel.

featured.title: Disk Cleaner
featured.summary: A Mac app that shows what's filling the disk, finds duplicates, and cleans up only what I approve.
featured.angle: Every API call needs a random token generated at launch, requests are limited to an allowlisted Host, and nothing is deleted without review. Removed files go to the Trash so they can be restored.
